verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's Flights product runs scheduled Python jobs, which are automations, and its page says it handles versioning for them. That covers only the versioning part of the story, and only as a single marketing mention. Missing for 10: documented review of automation changes, rollback to prior versions, depth on how Flights versioning works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Flights handle the infrastructure: Python runtime, scheduling, secrets, logging, and versioning.
Run Python jobs on a schedule for ingest, transformation, and operational tasks
